# Industrial Certified Training

> Industrial Certified Training, LLC delivers industry-certified safety and compliance training and certification programs for organizations and individuals, covering construction, maritime, radiation, healthcare, oil & gas, general industry, and hospitality.

Industrial Certified Training LLC empowers individuals and organizations to achieve professional goals with world-class, industry-certified training solutions. The company has over 25 years of experience, 1,000+ training topics, and has served 100,000+ businesses, including clients such as the U.S. Army, NASA, and Pfizer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ictraining.us/): Overview of services, industries served, and company stats.
- [About Us](https://ictraining.us/about-us.html): Company mission, vision, expertise, and culture.
- [Our Brands](https://ictraining.us/our-brands.html): Portfolio of certification brands — HAZWOPER/OSHA (https://hazwoper-osha.com), Entry Level Driver Training / ELDT (https://eldttraining.us), and OSHA certification (https://oshascorm.org).
- [Contact Us](https://ictraining.us/contact-us.html): Enrollment and general inquiries.

## Notes

- Legal entity: Industrial Certified Training, LLC.
